verdicts.why: May wounds Hunter to stop him shooting the undercover Jemma, and (per the summary) lets her and Gill go to keep her cover; May acts for Jemma there.
On the Arctic base raid, May, Coulson and Fitz take down the defenses; May defends Fitz while he hacks Hydra's system.
Hill calls Coulson after the raid; he gives her the intel on the Scepter/Strucker base and tells her to assemble the Avengers.
May takes Skye to Vault D and tries to calm her; Sif's arrival agitates Skye, who shoots herself with May's I.C.E.R., convincing Sif; May and Coulson then escort Sif away.
Coulson's team helps amnesiac Sif capture Vin-Tak; Coulson convinces Sif to leave Skye be and she warns him Skye may be more dangerous than he realizes.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: In 1945, Peggy leads an SSR raid on Hydra's last known base with Commandos Dugan and Morita at her side.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Peggy's old war unit. Two of them raid Hydra's last base with her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR agent who leads Dugan and Morita in a 1945 raid on Hydra.

verdicts.why: Peggy does raid Hydra's 1945 base with Commandos, but only Dugan and Morita are there (with SSR troops), not the whole unit; text and cards say which Commandos.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Dugan and fellow Commando Morita join Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra's last known base.
value.on_a_card_about_b: One of the Commandos on Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Dugan's unit. He and Morita raid Hydra's last base with Peggy in 1945.

verdicts.why: Only Dugan and Morita of the Commandos are on the 1945 raid (the group's page lists it as the unit's last action); the text should not imply the whole unit rides along.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Morita and fellow Commando Dugan join Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra's last known base.
value.on_a_card_about_b: One of the Commandos on Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Morita's unit. He and Dugan raid Hydra's last base with Peggy in 1945.

verdicts.why: Only Morita and Dugan of the Commandos are on the 1945 raid; the text should not imply the whole unit rides along.
Dugan and Morita raid Reinhardt's base together with Peggy and trade jokes while arresting his men.
With Coulson and May trapped in the prison office, Mack enlists Daisy and Reyes; Daisy goes for Coulson and May while Mack and Reyes find Morrow.
Fitz, Simmons and Mack interrogate the Radcliffe LMD and together realize the May LMD has a quantum brain.
Mack and Fitz arrive at Momentum to find more ghosts, who try to blow it up with them inside; Ghost Rider intervenes.
May calls Coulson and Mack back to the Playground and in private tells them Quake was at the Ghost Rider incident, tipping them to her location.
Coulson and Mack, forbidden by Director Mace from searching for Daisy, investigate together after May's tip.
The Watchdogs abduct Billy for the Darkhold Coulson entrusted to him; Coulson later trades the book for Billy at the Labyrinth.
Quake meets Yo-Yo on a bus to receive pills Yo-Yo stole from S.H.I.E.L.D. for her injuries.
Daisy and Simmons find each other amid the LMDs, prove they are human, and plan to hack into the Framework together to find the others.
Fitz and Daisy work to keep Yo-Yo and Mack alive as the Framework shuts down; the team refuses Fitz's offer to turn himself in, saying they forgive him.
Daisy rescues Coulson and May; they come back for her when the prisoners take her down; back at the Playground May tells her Coulson will never give up on her.
Daisy rescues Coulson and May from the director's office; Coulson and May come back to save her from the prisoners.
Piper guards the plugged-in Daisy aboard Zephyr One, suggests cutting the cloak to keep the Framework running, and Daisy wakes beside her as the jet attacks.
Mace approves a strike team of Rodriguez, Reyes and Daisy against Morrow; Yo-Yo argues she is fit for it when Mack objects.
Rodriguez decides to follow Piper's suggestion and cut the cloak to keep Simmons' and Daisy's Framework connection running while she guards them.
The Zephyr crew, Yo-Yo aboard, fight off Ivanov's men and race to the platform to rescue Coulson and May from Ivanov's android bodies.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
value.text: At the diner, Enoch's squad bursts in and freezes the team with a device, and Enoch has them taken away.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Enoch freezes at the diner and takes away.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The stranger who freezes the team at the diner and takes them.

verdicts.why: The rules decide it: one acting against the other in a scene together counts, no one-to-one needed. Enoch speaks to Coulson ('Phillip J. Coulson... Take them') and freezes and abducts each agent, so each taken member gets this stage (kind following each tie's later stage, ally/friend); Fitz, whom Enoch leaves as 'not on the list', is a separate case.
Talbot arrives at the ruined Playground, his soldiers detain Coulson, May, Simmons and Daisy, Coulson tries to explain, and Talbot reluctantly lets them go when Aida attacks.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
value.text: Talbot's soldiers detain May with Coulson and the team at the ruined Playground, then Talbot lets them fly off as Aida attacks.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Talbot detains at the ruined base, then lets go.
value.on_b_card_about_a: General who detains May's team at the ruined base, then lets them go.

verdicts.why: They do deal there (Talbot arrests May and the team, then lets them go), but a one-off arrest he lets go of does not turn their ally line to rival: Talbot keeps working with S.H.I.E.L.D. (the inquiry call in S4#22, May rescuing him from Hale in S5) until he turns in S5.
Radcliffe and Simmons cure May of Lucy Bauer's infection by killing and reviving her.
Simmons remembers Radcliffe scanned May's brain and warns Daisy of the May LMD in time to stop it from killing Coulson.
Piper brings Fitz to the standoff, where he insists May fly Zephyr One away before Aida finds them.
Coulson and Fitz are trapped between dimensions together, watch Morrow kill agents, and return through Aida's portal.
Piper does not appear in World's End: she is listed only as a mentioned character, and her parachute exit with Coulson's orders is told later (S5#11), not shown there.
Fitz's warning in the standoff is to his own team (he orders May to take off) and Talbot reacts to Aida's attack; Talbot never addresses Fitz, so it is a shared scene without an exchange.
Back from the dead, Bakuto attacks Colleen until Cage disarms him; when Rand arrives Bakuto says he recalls their last battle and looks forward to facing him again, then escapes.
Gao and Bakuto discuss their rivalry (his capture of her, his weakness for disciples) at the Hand's headquarters before Murakami reports Daredevil.
